extracted.stage: Ongoing matrimonial proceedings, hearing listed, heading to settlement or trial
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Marlow Family Law enquires about £40,000 of funding for a client's representation in matrimonial proceedings where the disputed pot is around £416,000 and a hearing is listed for 12 November.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry on behalf of your client, which we have received and logged. To take this further we would need confirmation of the jurisdiction of the proceedings, details of the assets in dispute and their composition, the stage and procedural history of the matter, and a costs estimate through to settlement or trial. We would also need your client's details for our standard onboarding and identity checks, together with your firm's engagement details. Once we have those we can review the enquiry; nothing in this message should be taken as an indication of whether funding will be offered or on what terms. Please do let us know if any documents are readily available.
